annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: The Digital Omnibus on AI amends the EU AI Act, the Civil Aviation Regulation and the Machinery Regulation. It delays high-risk obligations to December 2027 and August 2028, narrows the 'safety component' definition, moves machinery to the sectoral Section B of Annex I, extends SME/SMC relief, expands sandboxes and real-world testing, and adds prohibitions on nudification and AI-generated child sexual abuse material.
key_provisions_or_claims: High-risk obligations delayed to 2 Dec 2027 (Annex III) and 2 Aug 2028 (Annex I products).
'Safety component' redefined around an intended safety function; convenience, optimisation and automation functions excluded.
Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 moved to Annex I Section B; delegated acts must add AI requirements to its Annex III by 2 Aug 2028.
New Article 5 prohibitions on AI generating non-consensual intimate material and child sexual abuse material.
Regulatory sandboxes (including an EU-level one) and real-world testing extended to Annex I products; AI Office gets expanded exclusive supervision powers.
